text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
*pant, pant*... Couldn't beat Ikuno
again today... But...

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, Turbo won't lose!
And then, I'll beat Teio too!

The gap in ability remains as wide as ever.
Even so, Twin Turbo no longer loses heart.
That being said...
Somehow, I want to refine my running one step further and take it to the next level. To do that...

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Huh, Trainer...
Look, look, over there...

Looking over, Daitaku Helios and Mejiro Palmer
were standing some distance away in the training area.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Pretty please, bestie! I'm begging you!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Hm? What's up, bestie?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
In the end, over this past year,
I couldn't even manage a single win, right?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
"So I wanted to ask Helios-sensei, who won a graded race this year,
to teach me the secrets to runaway front-running!"

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Helios... sensei...?
You're gonna teach me... how to win?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Palmer-chin...
That seriously hurts my feelings~...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Huh, was that too selfish of me after all? Yeah, make sense.
Even if we're best friends, asking you how to win is a bit much...

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: That's not it, and don't call me Professor Helios~! We're total besties forever, no debts or favors between us, right?!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Let's run! I'll teach you
whatever I can♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Bestieee!!
Thank you, I so totally love ya~!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Oooooh... This is it!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Palmer was just getting advice from her friends, right? Then Turbo's gonna copy that and...!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
I can just get someone to teach me how to run!
How about that?!
choice_data_list: Yeah, I think that's a good idea.

text_block_list.text: Twin Turbo asking to be taught on her own initiative—it seemed like tremendous growth. But—

Leaving aside copying how to plead with someone,
who should I even ask to teach me...?

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Turbo's off!

Having struck upon an idea right away,
Twin Turbo sprang into action before thinking.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Pretty please, bestie! I'm asking you!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Huh, Turbo? Besties is since when?

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Turbo, in the end, you've just been
Turbo the entire year, haven't you?

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: "So, I want to learn Front Running from you, the 'majorly' awesome Helios-sensei!"

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
"A 'Graded' condition for me...?
Like, did I get seriously injured or something?"

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
You already wuv Turbo, right?
So tell me, tell me!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I don't really get it,
but are we straight-up copyin' Palmer-chin?

...A complete and utter rip-off from start to finish.
Such a short-sighted approach...

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Still, roger that☆ If it's Turbo, I'd be more than happy to teach her♪

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Really!?
Woohoo, yeah, yeah, yeah--!!
Even so, party-girl Daitaku Helios jumped right on board.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Alright, Turbo time☆
Let's do a freestyle front-runner battle for now!
One, two, three, and Fo~~!!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Aye-aye, sir!!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Ayy ayy, ayyyyâââ!!!!!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Guhhhhhh, Turbo full throttleee!!!
But, I can't go any further...

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Turbo, have way more fun with it!
Get into the groove, catch the super vibe☆

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
"Today's star is you, aw yeah♪
Riding all the way down this high-way♪"

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Huh... Helios...?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: "Laugh it up, jump high, let's kick it, yay♪ Ahahaha! Here we go, go, go★彡"

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Turbo's gonna... Turbo's gonna have that much fun too! Turbo totally can!!!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Orya orya oryaah!
Vroom vroom, vroooooooom☆

Her running... changed a little. Drawn in by the smile and rhythm,
her footwork grew lighter. Almost as if...

"The V-type turbo engine echoes from left to right.
For the first time, a sense of 'rhythm' was added
to Twin Turbo's running."

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Haa, haa, haa, I don't really get it,
but that was super fun~!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Ah, totally feel ya! In that case,
that is, woo~!! Breakth-roo~!!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Turbo, you gotta feel the hype more! If you do, you'll totally get in the groove just like I do in sprints☆

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Sprint... A sprint, huh...

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Trainer. If Turbo gets hyped up like Helios,
d'you think maybe I could do sprints too?

"If you can pull off the ultimate start dash,
shorter distances are more advantageous. That's one perspective.
However..."

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Ah, that's probably leaning towards totally impossible, right?
The legit sprinters have like twice the vibes and are crazy fast out of the gate.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Blasting out with a bang and then slugging it out—ain't that totally not Turbo's style?

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Crushing each other...
U-Uuuuu...

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Traaaiineer~...

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
"Yeah. Turbo hates it
when people try to overtake her!"

"Helios-senpai already said everything that needed to be said.
Twin Turbo's weapon isn't 'speed.'"

It all comes down to "bold decisiveness."
Polishing Front Runner tactics over medium or longer distances seems best.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Still, Trainer! Turbo learned something super important today!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
I'll learn more just like that and wiiin!
I'm gonna win and win and win like crazy!

Twin Turbo boldly talked up a big game.
Heading toward the Classic Class, her momentum only accelerated.
And then—

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Tokai Teio finally claims her first victory!
Breaks away with ease and cruises to a dominant win—!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"Has the opening gun for next year finally been fired?!
The rumored prodigy kicks into gear starting today!"

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: We're just getting started! Maybe I'll go ahead and snatch another win before the year's out.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Ooooh, Tokai Teio!!
Get 'em, Teio!!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Hey, look over here, Teio!
Did you see that just now!? I swear you looked!

Tokai Teio, seen as the center of her generation,
is finally making her move as well.

Looking toward next year, the gates opened for each of them.
Though their levels differed—
each strove toward their own goal.
